Subject: Exec alignment + technical deep dive - next steps

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for taking the time today, it was helpful to hear more about StellarPay's payment orchestration use case and the scale you expect in Q3. Quick recap/highlights from our call: 
- Primary goals: reduce per-transaction inference latency to <30ms p50 for fraud scoring, keep overall P95 <120ms for multi-step pipelines.
- Security: SOC 2 compliance required; VPC/private deployment preferred for production data.
- Throughput: peak ~2000 TPS (bursty) with average ~500 TPS; caching/batching will be important.
- Timeline: evaluating vendors now, goal to pilot in June, production by end of Q3.

To keep momentum we recommend doing a short technical deep dive next week (30-45m) - we can bring one of our solutions engineers to walk through architecture, latency/quantization trade-offs, and a proposed rollout plan. We also think an exec alignment intro (VP/CTO level) would help unblock procurement and exec sponsorship on your side. Rishi (cc'ed) can join that intro from our leadership.

Proposed next steps / times:
- Technical deep dive (30-45m) w/ SE: Tue Mar 24, 11:00-11:45 PT or Wed Mar 25, 10:00-10:45 PT
- Executive intro (VP/CTO) - short 20m: Wed Mar 25, 11:00-11:20 PT or Thu Mar 26, 9:00-9:20 PT

If you prefer, I can send a single invite that includes the SE deep dive and have Rishi join for the first 15-20 minutes for the exec alignment. Please let me know which times work (or share available slots) and who on your team you'd like on the call - you mentioned bringing Carlos (CTO) and possibly a product leader.

Attaching a one-pager and our proposed demo agenda for context.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
